app.title: Permitt — what your AI agents may do without asking
table.title: Who asks before acting
table.subtitle: One row per assistant, one state per capability; what runs without asking comes first. Click a cell for the reason.
table.none: No assistant found on this machine. Untick “Installed only” to see every host Permitt knows ({n}).
table.unknown: part of the state is not readable — see detail
legend: asks: every time · auto: without asking · judged: a model decides · allowlist(n) / denylist(n): except n patterns · sandboxed: without asking, inside a sandbox · off · unknown. Permitt changes nothing: act in each host's own settings.
panel.title: Why this cell says that
panel.subtitle: Each state rests on a setting in a file, or on a documented default. Nothing here is a judgement.
detail.pick: Click a cell in the table.
detail.evidence: What sets the state, strongest first
detail.ignored: Written in a file but not honoured there
findings.title: Findings
findings.subtitle: Most serious first. Each one says what you could do — displayed, never executed.
findings.none: No finding: every installed assistant asks before acting, as far as its files say.
